sender.zh: 「台灣電力公司」名義的簡訊（不是111短碼）、email或電話
sender.en: A text not from the 111 government short code, an email or a call in the name of Taipower

name.zh: 假台電：電費逾期將斷電，或帳單錯誤要退款
name.en: Fake Taipower: overdue bill means power cut, or a billing error refund

how.zh: 詐騙集團假冒台電發簡訊說「本期電費已逾期，若逾期將終止供電」並附連結，或寄email說電費欠繳、要到「線上服務平台」繳款，也有「帳單計算錯誤，您符合退款資格」的退款信。連結通往仿冒台電的網站，騙取個資和信用卡資料；也有附ZIP壓縮檔的郵件讓電腦中毒，或打電話要你核對身分證、轉接警察、匯款。台電的電費未繳提醒簡訊只從「111」政府短碼發送，內容只有電號和月份，不附連結；溢收電費只會轉入下期抵扣或臨櫃退款。
how.en: Scammers posing as Taipower send texts saying “your bill is overdue and power will be cut off” with a link, emails about unpaid bills with an “online service platform”, or refund emails saying “your bill was miscalculated and you qualify for a refund”. The links lead to fake Taipower sites that steal personal and card details; some emails carry a ZIP file that infects the computer, and some calls ask you to confirm your ID number, transfer you to the “police” or ask you to send money. Taipower's unpaid-bill reminders come only from the 111 government short code, show just your account number and month, and never have a link; overpayments are only credited to the next bill or refunded at a counter.

text.zh: 收到台電名義的簡訊或email，說電費逾期、將斷電，或帳單錯誤可退款。
text.en: A Taipower text or email says your bill is overdue and power will be cut, or that you are due a refund.

text.zh: 要你限期處理，點連結繳費或申請退款。
text.en: You must act by a deadline and tap a link to pay or claim the refund.

text.zh: 假網站要你輸入個資和信用卡號。
text.en: The fake site asks for your personal details and card number.

text.zh: 台灣電力公司：貴戶本期電費已逾期，請於今日內完成繳費，逾期將終止供電。線上繳費：[連結]
text.en: Taiwan Power Company: your electricity bill for this period is overdue. Pay today or supply will be cut off. Pay online: [link]

text.zh: 親愛的用戶：經重新計算，您上期電費溢收NT$1,350，符合退款資格。請於3日內點擊以下連結填寫退款資料：[連結]
text.en: Dear customer: after recalculation, you were overcharged NT$1,350 last period and qualify for a refund. Fill in your refund details via the link below within 3 days: [link]

zh: 收到台電簡訊說電費逾期要斷電
台電email說帳單算錯可以退款
台電簡訊有連結叫我繳費
有人自稱台電打來要我核對身分證
假台電網站要我輸入信用卡
en: i got a taipower text saying my bill is overdue and power will be cut
a taipower email said my bill was wrong and i can get a refund
a taipower text had a link telling me to pay
someone claiming to be taipower called and asked for my id number
a fake taipower site asked for my credit card

zh: 電費簡訊不是111發的，或內容有連結
說逾期就斷電、限今天繳
email遮住電號、沒有用電地址、附壓縮檔
en: A bill text not from 111, or one with a link.
Pay today or power will be cut.
An email that hides your account number, has no address or carries a ZIP file.
A refund offered by email or text.

zh: 不要點連結；用電費帳單上的電號在台電官網或台灣電力App查詢
輸入過卡號請馬上通知銀行停卡
en: Don't tap the link; check with the account number on your paper bill in the official website or Taipower app.
If unsure, call Taipower customer service or 165.
If you entered a card number, ask your bank to block it at once.
